Santa Clara County Superior Court Judge Sunil R. Kulkarni rejected Apple’s request to dismiss the case, finding that Schulze adequately supported her legal claims. The judge also denied her request to represent a class of female employees who suffered job discrimination over the last four years. Meanwhile, **Cisco Systems Inc.** is facing a suit brought by California's civil rights agency alleging bias against a Dalit employee based on caste.

recent_articles.title: At Norway Chess, the Armageddon exhausts the players and thrills the crowd | Chess News - The Indian Express
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Divya Deshmukh**, after a grueling four-day run in the Armageddon tiebreaker format at Norway Chess, emerged exhausted but victorious.  The Indian player's tears were not from joy, but from the sheer mental strain of playing this intense format for four consecutive days. **Magnus Carlsen**, the tournament's host and reigning world champion, acknowledged the intensity of the Armageddon, stating it is "pretty exhausting" for players due to its fast time controls.  Norway Chess has incorporated the Armageddon since 2019, making it a defining feature of the tournament.

recent_articles.title: Firing incident indicates deteriorating law and order, says Pralhad Joshi - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Union Minister Pralhad Joshi** expressed concern over the deteriorating law and order situation in **Dharwad**, citing a recent firing incident as an example. He alleged involvement of high-level officials, including police officers, in the case due to their failure to arrest the prime suspect, **Sundar Pal**.  Joshi also criticized the police for not including the accused's name in the FIR until media reports prompted action.

recent_articles.title: INDIA Bloc Revival In Bengal? Support For Mamata Banerjee Over Nephew's Assault
recent_articles.rephrased_article: Despite losing the Bengal election, **Mamata Banerjee**'s stature within the **INDIA** bloc remains strong. Opposition leaders condemned the assault on her nephew, **Abhishek Banerjee**, by a mob in Sonarpur, South 24 Parganas.  **Mallikarjun Kharge**, **Akhilesh Yadav**, and **Arvind Kejriwal** accused the BJP of fostering political violence, while the ruling party denied involvement and blamed the TMC for mischaracterizing public anger. The incident has led to calls for stronger law-and-order measures in West Bengal.

recent_articles.title: Congress’s message to Siddaramaiah as DKS takes charge: Won’t allow you to rest - Karnataka News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Congress** general secretary **KC Venugopal** declared that the party will not allow former Karnataka Chief Minister Siddaramaiah to rest, urging him to continue playing an active role in both state and national politics.  After Siddaramaiah's resignation, **DK Shivakumar** was unanimously elected as the new CLP leader and formally named Karnataka’s next Chief Minister.  Siddaramaiah congratulated Shivakumar and called for a "second freedom struggle" to protect the country's unity and integrity. The Congress leadership expressed confidence that under Shivakumar's leadership, they will return to power in the 2028 elections.

recent_articles.title: Vinesh Phogat’s return to wrestling: What a mess - India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Vinesh Phogat**, one of India's greatest-ever wrestlers, returned to the wrestling mat in a bid to qualify for the 2026 Asian Games. However, her comeback was marred by conflict with the **Wrestling Federation of India (WFI)**, which imposed restrictions on her weight class and created an atmosphere of tension throughout the competition. Despite facing challenges like being denied entry into the stadium and experiencing biased officiating, Phogat persevered but ultimately lost in the semi-final. The WFI's actions sparked outrage from fans and athletes alike, highlighting a systemic issue within the federation that needs to be addressed.

recent_articles.title: Kulgam Police attach houses worth over Rs 1 crore in anti-drug crackdown
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Police** in Kulgam district, south Kashmir, attached two residential properties worth over ₹1 crore, alleging they were acquired through proceeds from illegal drug trafficking. The first property, a house valued at ₹50 lakh belonging to Imtiyaz Ahmad Mir, was attached in connection with an FIR registered at Yaripora police station. A second property, a single-storey house worth ₹52 lakh owned by Feroze Ahmad Khan, was also attached under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances (NDPS) Act after obtaining approval from the competent authority under the Smugglers and Foreign Exchange Manipulators (Forfeiture of Property) Act (SAFEMA). The authorities stated that all legal formalities were followed.

recent_articles.title: Abhishek Banerjee Sonarpur attack: TMC leader alleges BJP wanted to kill him; shirt torn, specs broken, Stones, eggs and 'chor chor' chants - West Bengal News | India Today
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Abhishek Banerjee**, TMC national general secretary, was attacked by a mob in Sonarpur, West Bengal while visiting the family of a man allegedly killed in post-poll violence. The incident involved stones, eggs, and verbal abuse, with protesters accusing him of corruption and demanding security for the area. **Mamata Banerjee**, Chief Minister of West Bengal, visited him at the hospital and blamed the BJP for orchestrating the attack.  **Derek O'Brien**, a Trinamool Congress Rajya Sabha MP, questioned the withdrawal of security during the visit and called for an investigation. The BJP condemned the violence but denied any involvement in the attack.
